searchText: forgive the ignorance on my end, but does that mean the miner "tip" is then phased in as wallets support it (eg.. increases over time) .. I easily might not be understanding how current transaction submitted in a post-1559 world would be handled from a fee breakdown perspective.. If you submit a legacy transaction (with just a `gas_price`), then in the clients they will *treat* it like a 1559 transaction with a `max_fee_per_gas == max_inclusion_fee == legacy_gas_price`. operationally what does the miner get to keep from the transaction? nothing until there is a tip? for further, clarity, does that mean that legay transactions (e..g I stop metamask from updating going forward) will have their entire fee burned? The miner gets everything over the base fee for the block (in the case of a legacy transaction). If you submit a legacy transaction with a gas price of 500 and the base fee for the block you are included in is 100, then the miner will get 400 per gas. got it.. thank you!

excerpts.author: mrabino1
excerpts.content: forgive the ignorance on my end, but does that mean the miner "tip" is then phased in as wallets support it (eg.. increases over time) .. I easily might not be understanding how current transaction submitted in a post-1559 world would be handled from a fee breakdown perspective..

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: If you submit a legacy transaction (with just a `gas_price`), then in the clients they will *treat* it like a 1559 transaction with a `max_fee_per_gas == max_inclusion_fee == legacy_gas_price`.

excerpts.author: mrabino1
excerpts.content: operationally what does the miner get to keep from the transaction? nothing until there is a tip?   for further, clarity, does that mean that legay transactions (e..g I stop metamask from updating going forward) will have their entire fee burned?

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: The miner gets everything over the base fee for the block (in the case of a legacy transaction).

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: If you submit a legacy transaction with a gas price of 500 and the base fee for the block you are included in is 100, then the miner will get 400 per gas.
